facts.fact: Per a Digiday report, the Financial Times recently discovered fraudulent inventory of over $1 million per month.
facts.quote: the Financial Times recently discovered fraudulent inventory of over $1 Million dollars per month.

facts.fact: Over 6,000 premium domains were spoofed in the Methbot Scheme, a breach the page attributes to a Russian cybercrime ring earlier in 2017.
facts.quote: over 6,000 premium domains were spoofed in a breach now known as the Methbot Scheme

facts.fact: The Methbot Scheme generated as much as $5 million in revenue per day, according to a Forbes report cited by the page.
Per a MarTech Today analysis cited by Digiday, only 34 of the 500 most-trafficked sites in the US used ads.txt as of September 6, 2017.
facts.quote: Of the 500 most-trafficked sites in the US, only 34 use ads.txt

facts.fact: According to the IAB, ads.txt stands for Authorized Digital Sellers and is a method publishers use to publicly declare the companies they authorize to sell their digital inventory.
facts.quote: Ads.txt stands for Authorized Digital Sellers and is a simple, flexible and secure method
